title: Pope Urban VIII consecrates the new St. Peter's Basilica
summary: After 120 years of building, the new basilica of St. Peter in Rome, with Michelangelo's dome, was consecrated by Pope Urban VIII.
reason: The old Constantinian basilica was crumbling, and the popes wanted a church to express the glory of Rome.
significance: It became the largest church of its age and the central symbol of the Catholic Church.
